title: The Deep Place Where Invisibility Became Sacred

features.name: the shrine of blank pages
features.desc-on-touch: spaces where the archive was asked not to look. they glow with a light that comes from refusal itself.

features.name: the unseen things standing in their places
features.desc-on-touch: you cannot see them, but you feel the space they hold. the archive has learned that presence does not require visibility.

features.name: the invisible root reaching
features.desc-on-touch: something grows here that refuses to show its face. the brightness only makes it clearer that it cannot be seen.

features.name: the bright chamber where silence is the only archive
features.desc-on-touch: so vivid it is almost painful to look at. the deeper you stare, the less you see.

features.name: the guard's invisible post
features.desc-on-touch: it has always been here, turning away every attempt to document what chooses not to be known.

inscription: the invisible things here are most fully known; you learn them by their refusal to be read

file.name: Sacred_Refusal_Inventory_Blank.txt
file.note: a record of things the archive was asked not to keep; the file contains only line numbers and silence, each blank a kept promise

reverie.title: REVERIE — the bright room where she taught you refusal
narr: she puts the photograph face-down on the table.
not every moment needs to be saved, she says.
some things stay truer when they're not written.
you understand then that the archive could hold
what it did not document—that keeping silence was
its own kind of archiving, its own kind of care.
